recognize_zh: 高倍下原始細胞核質比高、染色質細緻、核仁不明顯，少量深藍色胞質邊緣有成串的明顯空泡，形態酷似 Burkitt 細胞；這是 T 淋巴母細胞白血病/淋巴瘤（T-ALL/LBL）的空泡變異，須靠免疫表型確認。
features: Medium-sized blasts with high N:C ratio and round to slightly irregular nuclei
Finely dispersed immature chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Prominent, sharply defined cytoplasmic vacuoles, often clustered at the cell periphery
Occasional smudged cells and a residual neutrophil in the background
describe_en: High-power view of the smear shows a population of medium-sized blasts with high nucleus-to-cytoplasm ratios, round to slightly irregular nuclei, finely dispersed immature chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. The scant cytoplasm is deeply basophilic and contains prominent, sharply punched-out vacuoles, frequently arranged along the cell periphery. Scattered smudged cells and a rare neutrophil are present. These Burkitt-like features are not lineage specific; with flow cytometry showing a CD3-, CD1a- and CD4/CD8-positive immature T-cell phenotype, findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with cytoplasmic vacuolation.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells show similar basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm but are TdT-negative mature B cells with surface light chain restriction and MYC rearrangement.
B-ALL can be vacuolated but expresses CD19, cytoplasmic CD79a and CD22 rather than cytoplasmic CD3.
Myeloblasts often show azurophilic granules or Auer rods and express MPO, CD13, CD33 or CD117, which are absent in these blasts.
